releaseNotes: v8.14.6: Precision Smart Glossary Filtering & Token Optimization: 1) Prevent Volume Label Token Leaks: resolves regex splitting bug where terms like '1年1巻' or '2年6巻' were split on digits into the isolated kanji '年', causing all 40+ volume entries to falsely match every paragraph containing '年' (saving 1,500-3,000+ unnecessary tokens per chunk); 2) Preserved Alphanumeric CJK Keys: properly treats mixed terms like '3年A組' and '1年1巻' as single holistic keys; 3) Generic Stop-Key Expansion: added volume, volumes, vol, vols to generic filter list.
